A FREE GIFT FOR STUDENTS

Knowledge for Everyone.

Learn. Explore. Imagine. Create. Neuro AI was built so that every student — in Ghotki and everywhere — can ask questions, understand difficult ideas and build new skills.

The student experience is free. Neuro answers live with a free realtime AI for every visitor, no key needed — and when the site owner adds a free Gemini key in the Admin Panel, it answers with Google Gemini instead. Its built-in learning engine answers offline on your device if no AI service can be reached.

ABOUT NEURO AI

An Educational AI Project by Saravers

Neuro AI by Saravers is an educational AI platform designed to help students explore knowledge, understand difficult concepts, practice coding, discover books and express their creativity through intelligent digital tools.

Our Mission

“To make learning more accessible, interactive and inspiring for students.”

Neuro AI is a free gift for students: a single companion for questions, study material, books, coding and creativity that answers in the student's own language — English, Urdu, Roman Urdu, Sindhi and more. The student-facing experience is designed to stay free wherever practical; the project is honest that hosted AI models, image services and hosting carry real usage costs, which is why Neuro also carries a built-in learning engine that runs on the visitor's own device at zero cost, and answers live with Gemini when the site owner adds a free Gemini key in the Admin Panel.

Meet Neuro — The Future Robot

The platform is designed so a physical humanoid robot named Neuro can become its body: the laptop thinks, the robot speaks and moves.

How it will work

  1. A student asks by voice or types on the laptop.
  2. Speech is transcribed to text; the AI generates an answer.
  3. The full answer appears on screen, with examples or diagrams.
  4. Text-to-speech converts the answer to audio.
  5. Audio plays through the robot's speaker, its head moves, and a digital mouth animates in sync.

The architecture keeps audio playback and movement commands in separate, configurable modules, with a safe fallback if the robot disconnects. Bluetooth audio alone does not provide microphone or motor control — movement needs the robot's documented API, SDK or serial/USB controller.

In development Robot integration is not claimed as working — it will be announced only after testing with real hardware. The simulation on the right shows the intended experience.

Simulation Mode

Neuro is idle. Press the button and Neuro will greet you — watch the head tilt and the mouth move while it speaks.

Simulation only — no robot hardware is connected. Speech uses your browser's voice.

SETTINGS

Make It My Way

Personalize how Neuro answers, speaks and creates. Your preferences are saved under your account on this device for 7 days (guest preferences are kept separately) — passwords are only ever stored as salted hashes.

Answers & Language

With Auto, Neuro replies in the language of your message — English, Urdu, Roman Urdu or Sindhi.

Reduce motion
Calms floating and entrance animations.

Voice

Read answers aloud
Neuro speaks each new answer automatically.

Voices come from your browser and device, so available languages vary. Speech recognition works best in Chrome.

Image Studio Defaults

Chat History & Privacy

Your saved chats and lists are kept for 7 days and then automatically deleted. Sign-in lasts 24 hours. Everything stays in this browser, under your own account — sign in from the Account page to keep your things separate from other students on this device.

Neuro never stores plain-text passwords (only salted SHA-256 hashes). In the production version, chat with a hosted model would travel over an encrypted connection to the project server, where keys stay secret and rate limits protect the free service.

API Keys

Demonstration only: this browser-based admin login is not a real security boundary. Keys saved here are stored in this browser for the classroom demo — never enter a real, paid API key here. For a public production website, admin sign-in and keys belong on the server (see the backend package).

Text AI Key

Powers Neuro Chat, Study Tools, CreateLab, Coding Help and Voice answers. When a key is saved for the selected provider, those tools use that provider only — every answer comes from it, and if a call fails they show the plain error instead of a built-in answer. Each provider keeps its own saved key, model and endpoint, so switching providers never loses a key. Remove the active provider's key to return to the free realtime AI (with the built-in learning engine as offline fallback).

NVIDIABuild-Autogen-26 — your NVIDIA Build deployment. Paste your NVIDIA API key below; the chat model is nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b (Nemotron Parse reads documents/images and cannot chat). The field stays editable.

Default NVIDIA Build endpoint. Paste a custom / autogen deployment URL instead if your deployment uses one. NVIDIA blocks direct browser calls, so chat is sent to this endpoint through the site's secure proxy (/api/nvidia) — which is why NVIDIA chat and Test Connection work on the live Vercel site.

Not set

Image AI Key

Optional upgrade for AI Image Studio — the studio's default engine is the free AI image service, which needs no key. When a key is saved here, the studio tries this provider first; if that call fails it shows the error and generates with the free AI image service instead, with the on-device art engine as the final backup.
